# convoy_portal_link (Resource)

A portal link gives one of your customers a hosted UI to inspect deliveries and (optionally) manage the endpoints that share an owner ID. Destroying the resource revokes the link.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convoy_portal_link" "acme" {
  name                = "Acme webhooks portal"
  owner_id            = convoy_endpoint.acme.owner_id
  can_manage_endpoint = true
}

output "acme_portal_url" {
  value     = convoy_portal_link.acme.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Portal link name.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Portal authentication: `static_token` (long-lived token in the URL) or `refresh_token` (short-lived tokens, see the `convoy_portal_link_token` ephemeral resource). Changing this forces a new portal link.
- `can_manage_endpoint` (Boolean) Allow the customer to create and edit endpoints from the portal.
- `endpoints` (Set of String) Explicit endpoint IDs to expose. Deprecated by Convoy in favour of `owner_id`.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID; the portal shows every endpoint with this owner ID. Either `owner_id` or `endpoints` is required.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new object to be created.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `endpoint_count` (Number) Number of endpoints visible in the portal.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the portal link.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Portal access token.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Portal URL to share with the customer (contains the access token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import convoy_portal_link.acme 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K/01H0JATTVCXZK8FRDX1M1JN3QY
```
